correctness.rationale: Both independently implemented complete local ramification searches agree on all 60 tame maps among 1536 degree-five maps, with 36 index-three-fourfold maps. Exact 36-element rational coordinate action produces unique orbit of size36; geometric A5 follows inertia generation, transitivity, and subgroup structure. Symbolic factor coverage to degree4 and explicit GF16/GF8 point coverage ensure no unexamined finite ramification.

The known power/Rédei cyclic classes are expressly excluded; full-text comparisons and targeted mathematical-record searches identified no covering arithmetic A5 classification, subject to unindexed older literature.
